items.claim: CEO 表示上修 2026 全年營收成長展望至 17%
items.quote: raising our 2026 revenue growth outlook to 17%
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CFO 給出 2026 全年營收區間指引
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CFO 給出 2026 全年 Non-GAAP 營益率指引區間
items.quote: Non-GAAP operating margin in the range of 43.5% to 44.5%.
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明 Hexagon 併購對 2026 EPS 造成稀釋
items.quote: We expect it to be dilutive to the tune of about $0.28.
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明近期有機成長的邊際利潤率水準
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CEO 針對 AI 是否威脅 EDA 基礎工具可防禦性，表態對自身基礎工具地位有信心
items.quote: very confident in our position in the base tool
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO 評論基礎工具的競爭地位仍屬業界最佳
items.quote: our competitor of the base tool is anyway best-in-class
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明新推出的三個 AI Super Agent（含 ChipStack）串連整個晶片設計流程
items.quote: Together, these solutions span the entire chip design flow
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO 介紹 AgentStack 作為 AI Super Agent 的頭部代理框架
items.quote: AgentStack, the head agent framework for our AI Super Agent
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO 提及與某全球晶圓代工大廠簽下 IP 業務史上最大單一合約
items.quote: closed a record deal with a leading global foundry
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO 提及某半導體設計大廠大幅增加 Innovus 用量
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CEO 提及一家指標型 AI 基礎設施公司擴大採用簽核解決方案
items.quote: a marquee AI infrastructure company expanded their usage
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

items.claim: CFO 指出 2026 財測假設出口管制法規維持現狀不變
items.quote: export control regulations that exist today remain
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明中國占 Q1 營收比重及全年預期
items.quote: China, it was 13% of Q1 revenue
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CFO 揭露 Q1 已動用 2 億美元庫藏股回購
items.quote: we used $200 million to repurchase Cadence shares
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CFO 指引 2026 全年約用 50% 自由現金流回購股票
items.quote: approximately 50% of our free cash flow to repurchase
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CFO 說明 Hexagon 收購的股票/現金支付結構
items.quote: we paid 30% of the acquisition price in shares and 70%
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CFO 預期 Hexagon 併購案將於 2027 年轉為增益
items.quote: We'd expect it to be accretive in 2027.
items.speaker: John Wall, CFO

items.claim: CEO 承諾 2030 年前推出下一代硬體平台 Z4
items.quote: we'll have a Z4 system before 2030.
items.speaker: Anirudh Devgan, CEO

qa_flags.question: Andrew DeGasperi 追問 physical AI／agentic 貨幣化時程是否已提前於原先講的兩個合約週期
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 先鬆口說有可能提前於 2 個合約週期，隨即補一句「I don't want to predict too much」收回具體時程承諾，未給出可證偽的時間點
